scope: same current shared source in both built modules; isolated native-entry and DOM bridge contracts, real CSV/schema parser

tests.name: configured AI and predictive imports share one locked lightweight view with optional metadata
predictive missing category shows the task configuration action rather than a category picker
task API entry shows the exact receiving fields without any manual upload or confirmation controls
API field view displays supplier parameter names without internal encoded storage keys
API task view cannot be used to submit or download manual lists through public UI actions
manual task payload explicitly carries the captured MANUAL channel
unknown task input channels are rejected before a context read
task record source uses persisted entry channel and never infers missing history
AI missing configuration is repaired in task configuration rather than an import-time selector
task imports preserve custom import fields, stable field keys, enum values and five-level priority in both methods
dynamic CSV templates contain the actual category import fields and no follow-up fields
dynamic XLSX templates are genuine local workbooks containing the same classification schema
explicit column mapping preserves foreign custom values and refuses duplicate or missing required mappings
required custom columns, invalid enums and business codes remain real import errors
native predictive review keeps invalid rows and confirms only a freshly rechecked valid subset
native predictive row edits invalidate the old subset token and require another full check
priority or text changes invalidate the exact previous preview before submission
task category configuration refresh preserves the draft and invalidates old mapping and preview
a stale asynchronous task context cannot replace newer configured category fields
pending file reads block old-list submission and a changed scope receives no late file or context data
unknown import keeps one request identity and uses only exact-task reconciliation
operators receive the real administrator import denial without new records or native list mutation
cancel requires an explicit discard for a dirty draft and never writes business or native history
AI and predictive capacities are shown and forwarded to the real inspector without truncation
large previews paginate their full checked rows and submit every row rather than only the visible page
unified task records render full import field details and enum labels without native acceptance claims
unified task lists paginate all returned records and keep later-page field details available
supplier-only scene columns are parsed separately and never sent as business fields
task detail shows captured supplier parameters and custom column values with escaped labels
the generated inspector preserves large AI capacity while enforcing each task limit without truncation
AI task import and old upload/template actions all target the exact local task ID
native AI task entry follows its own exact source even when scene configuration differs
predictive manual entry routes to shared import and source-locked API tasks never mix lists
taskless customer import keeps its original path and exact predictive task imports use the unified UI
